subject: Create ONE NEW reusable isolated whole wide spruce tree sprite, using Image 1 as the approved STYLE AND SPECIES reference. Image 1 is a finished riverside scene: do NOT reproduce the scene or cut out pixels. Draw an original standalone tree closely resembling the broad spruce to the LEFT of the lamp: a broad conifer with a slightly bent pointed top, uneven drooping cloud-like branch tiers and ragged individual tips; lower branch skirt broad and full, with several interlocking soft clustered masses. NO stacked geometric triangles, no Christmas ornament tree. A sturdy SHORT natural brown trunk and small root toes are visible beneath the foliage, occupying about 17 percent of total height. Width:height near 100:128. No side views, no extra variants, no occlusion. This tree will be lit dynamically, so draw MATERIAL ALBEDO: dim neutral deep olive-green and blue-green foliage, natural umber bark, no yellow lamplight or bright rim light baked into the tree. Match the reference's calm coherent pixel masses, selectively clustered foliage texture and one-to-two ORIGINAL-pixel near-black ink contour, not a noisy pine-needle texture. The uneven branch tiers should support round volume when relit, rather than being a flat outline. Design at a TRUE native resolution about 100 by 128 pixels; display those square pixels enlarged without smoothing. Fewer than 20 coherent colors. High fixed oblique game camera like the reference, tree facing viewer. Center the whole tree, roots included, with a large clear margin. The entire background must be completely flat pure vivid magenta #ff00ff, a removable chroma key. NO ground plane, no cast shadow, no reflection, no glow, no mist, no grass, no labels, no checkerboard, no white matte, no partial tree. Solid opaque tree interior. This is a game asset drawing, NOT another landscape concept painting.
